body: We do already have duplicate symbols in starship (e.g. .NET's TFM and Dart use the same symbol, while perl and ocaml render identically in some emoji sets) so this isn't a killer. I'd like to get reviews from other maintainers signing off on this idea before proceeding though, since this has traditionally been a contentious issue.
